SR5WalkRun.Settings.DeclarationMode.Name: Movement Declaration
SR5WalkRun.Settings.DeclarationMode.Hint: Once per round: movement mode is declared at the start of the first initiative pass and locked for the entire round. Per phase: mode can be changed each initiative pass; if run is declared in any pass the round limit becomes the run maximum.
SR5WalkRun.Toggle.Tooltip: Declare movement mode for this initiative phase
SR5WalkRun.Settings.RunningModifiers.Hin: Apply automatic modifiers to dice pools: −2 to all active tests, +2/+4 to Physical Defense, no effect on resist/soak or the Running skill test. !!! Requires the sr5-ae-neg-filter module.
SR5WalkRun.Settings.GmMovementOverride.H: When enabled, the GM can move tokens beyond their declared walk/run distance limits without being blocked.
SR5WalkRun.Settings.DistanceVisibility.H: Controls which combatants' movement distances are visible to players in the combat tracker. The GM always sees all distances.
SR5WalkRun.Settings.OpenRunningTestOnSpr: When enabled, activating Sprint in the combat tracker automatically opens the actor's Running skill test dialog.
